publicationModel: Reviewed claims in this ledger feed generated pages. Implementation repositories remain authoritative for code and operational detail.

facts.title: Governed connector instances
facts.summary: Source Catalog manages tenant-scoped connector instances while retaining only opaque secret references and governed connection metadata.

facts.title: Version-pinned multi-Agent composition
facts.summary: Solution Composer persists immutable dependency plans with exact capability versions and digests, qualification evidence, cache reuse, and stale-plan invalidation.

facts.title: Least-privilege Agent tool delegation
facts.summary: Agents declare MCP requirements; Workflows authorize exact bindings without turning MCPs into hidden Workflow steps or giving Agents provider credentials.

facts.title: Immutable profile-bound Agents
facts.summary: One hardened Generic Agent image supports isolated logical Agents with immutable profiles, separate identities, queues, scaling, network policy, rollout, and rollback.

facts.title: Qualified Hello World path
facts.summary: The promoted Hello World AgentCards are version 0.2.1, and publication remains a separate MCP action after human approval.

facts.title: Production-shaped RAG ingestion
facts.summary: Durable PostgreSQL jobs, shadow generations, RabbitMQ delivery, pgvector, Tika, ClamAV, Presidio, ACL and lineage checks, and fail-closed external adapters now shape ingestion.

facts.title: Content-minimized retrieval evidence
facts.summary: Retrieval returns ContextPack, CitationManifest, and receipts while retaining content-minimized evidence for 30 days by default.

facts.title: External Copilot and Claude access
facts.summary: MCP-capable clients use delegated user identity, identity-filtered discovery, purpose and policy context, and platform-owned upstream credentials through the capability gateway.

facts.title: One governed Studio workspace
facts.summary: MCPs, Agents, Workflows, Services, and Solutions share one searchable, tabbed workspace with typed drafts, dependency graphs, AI-assisted interpretation, and explicit runtime links.

facts.title: Solutions compose reusable Services
facts.summary: A Service is a reusable executable intent-to-outcome contract pinned to approved Workflows; a Solution is the final user-facing composition, complete dependency graph, experience contract, and lifecycle built from Services and lower-level capabilities.

facts.title: One entry point, entitlement-shaped experiences
facts.summary: One authenticated entry point presents Builder/Admin Studio, Consumer My Solutions, or delegated headless access by entitlement; consumer-only users land on /my-solutions and launch Solutions through published Service Experience Contracts.

facts.title: Resource-bound policy and entitlements
facts.summary: Tool decisions bind the exact resource, purpose, input digest, side-effect class, approval, policy rules, and entitlement IDs; side effects require an explicit scope.

facts.title: Durable admitted Service Runs
facts.summary: Run Coordinator admits intent before persistence, records evidence, supports constrained dynamic composition, and blocks execution behind an exact-plan approval when required.

facts.title: Reusable immutable delivery
facts.summary: Shared CI/CD builds immutable images with SBOM and provenance, then performs rollout-safe deployment updates and rollback.

facts.title: Repaired identity and governed workspaces
facts.summary: The public Keycloak login path is restored, and governed MongoDB workspace access uses controlled identity and secret-reference boundaries.
